housing-infrastructure.quote: This new act builds on that progress by cutting red tape and supporting faster, more affordable housing development statewide.

Michigan is already leading with historic housing investments, streamlined permitting, Rate Relief Mortgages to help first‑time buyers save hundreds each month, and expanded tax credits to boost affordable development.

The 21st Century ROAD to Housing Act puts Michigan on the fast track to lowering housing costs and building the homes hard-working families need. It’s a major step forward at a time when 9 in 10 Americans say homeownership feels out of reach.

Today, I am declaring a state of emergency for Antrim, Cheboygan, and Emmet counties following severe rain and flooding that has damaged local roads and infrastructure.

This declaration will deploy critical resources and financial assistance to families and first responders.

We can’t fix the damn roads without the hardworking crews who get the job done.
 
Repairing our roads has supported 118,000 good-paying construction jobs, helping families thrive all across the state.
